notes.title: Release the Birbs
notes.notes: [p]You can now race in a new [b]Factory[/b] map that is not available in the demo[/p][p][/p][p]Full release has it's own scoreboards, so if you played the demo, your time is not carried over to the full game[/p][p][/p][p]Remember that this is just an early access release and a lot of stuff is going to change and be added. My plans are big, but I am just a single person developing in my free time, so it will take some time. [/p][p]Hope you can enjoy this release and set some nice times in the new map.[/p][p][/p][p]If you come across any bugs or problems, let me know on the Steam Community or on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/gregstr.eu"]Bluesky[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for supporting this endeavour.[/p]
